method: Each school's own pages and PDFs, fetched with curl and the site's static contact user agent MarlonJack/1.0 (contact: admin@rmhstudios.com), one request at a time, 3 s or more apart plus jitter, robots.txt honoured; a site that refused (403, 429, a bot challenge) was recorded as refused and not worked around. Every figure's evidence was then re-fetched from its url on the check date and kept only when found verbatim on the page (whitespace, quotes and dashes folded; letters and digits in order for tables; for an animated counter, the label in the text and the number in an HTML data attribute) with the value inside it.
rules: Official pages only: the school's own domain and PDFs hosted there. Never the AAMC MSAR profiles, AACOMAS or the Choose DO explorer, US News, Admit.org, Student Doctor Network, forums, prep companies or Wikipedia, even where they quote the school.

Only what the page states: a value is exactly as the page writes it, never computed, inferred or rounded; mean and median are kept apart, and a figure whose statistic the page does not name is OTHER with the page's words as its qualifier.
Classes before the 2024 entering class are dropped. A class the page does not date ("current", "most recent") keeps the page's label and enteringYear null.
A figure for an MD-PhD (or DO-PhD, MSTP) program only says so in its qualifier.
verifier: pnpm exec tsx scripts/medschools/check-class-profiles.ts re-fetches every class url politely and reports each figure found or not found
